spec_results.feature_detection: exact-sign convexity, finite-profile E closed form, chaining, corners, carrier images work on all cases; annulus: 0 features (D1 inactive) for g=1.2 and g=1

findings: F1 300k INFEASIBLE under the decided D1 law (proxy): M6 dC = 797064 +/- 23076 added mandatory BL complexity (> 2.6x the 300k budget). TE+tip line alone 316039 > 300k. Polar h0-graded resolution around a crease costs ~2*pi/s^2*ln(R_f/h0) per spanwise station (s = 0.18), and h0 = 2e-6.

F2 Faceting sensitivity: the rounded M6 LE (coarse original facets, turns 30.74-31.3 deg vs threshold 30.73 deg) is classified as a crease line (89 segments, dC 267464) plus 6 tip-LE fragments with free-end corners (dC 213560). Detection on original facet dihedrals is resolution-dependent for curved walls without authority.

F3 O1 law is continuous with finite R_f for g=1, but g=1 with the decided E rule (Gc=d/h0) makes every convex facet edge with turn > 1.02 deg a feature: M6 3704 features, dC ~1e14 (infeasible); fixtures fine.
F4 Carrier ends: imaging only the end segment leaves 0.4-4.7% D1 asymmetry on the plane (vs 12-55% without image); spec should mirror every feature segment within R_f of a reflective carrier.

F5 Continuity of the D1 part: support boundary 4.4e-9, segment switches 4.3e-9 relative for 1e-9 moves (all-active); faded tensor continuous at R_f. Gradation of the composed directional size equals the hn_f slope 0.18 near features (0.37 at 0.5T where the BL law itself switches).

F6 2D TE v8: E = 8.6 (feature), recorded circumferential size 2.5e-4 is already finer than hn_f(rho) for rho >= 3e-4; D1 adds <= 0.6 to a region complexity of 1793 (D1 replacing the corner limit could only coarsen there).
decision: WP-A spec mechanics confirmed; O1 law continuous; 300k feasibility FAILS for A5 (requires a user decision: budget/profile for A5, or the D1 detection rule on faceted curved walls and its extent). M1 should not start before that decision.
